items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Then Jimmy Smith, Stay Loose. It’s a pretty big band. [INTERVIEWEE] I’m on that too?

ctx.x: I didn’t know I played on that. I know that record. I’ve heard it. But I didn’t know I played on it.

When I told Ken about it, I said, “I remember my dad had this,” because I remember the cover. Because my dad – oh yeah. Like I say, you’re the soundtrack to my entire . . . Then, Don Sebesky and the Jazz-Rock Syndrome, Don Sebesky big band. I hadn’t actually heard this. It’s got – kind of interesting. Then Jimmy Smith, Stay Loose. It’s a pretty big band.
